sentences.text: Chess is a two-player strategy board game played on a chessboard , a checkered gameboard with 64 squares arranged in an 8 × 8 grid .	strategy	abstract strategy game	board game	board game	chessboard	chessboard
The game is played by millions of people worldwide .

Each player begins with 16 pieces : one king , one queen , two rooks , two knights , two bishops , and eight pawns .	king	king (chess)	queen	queen (chess)	pieces	chess piece	rooks	rook (chess)	knights	knight (chess)	bishops	bishop (chess)	pawns	pawn (chess)
Each of the six piece types moves differently , with the most powerful being the queen and the least powerful the pawn .	queen	queen (chess)	pawn	pawn (chess)	moves	#Movement
The objective is to checkmate the opponent 's king by placing it under an inescapable threat of capture .	king	king (chess)	checkmate	checkmate
To this end , a player 's pieces are used to attack and capture the opponent 's pieces , while supporting each other .	pieces	chess piece

In addition to checkmate , the game can be won by of the opponent , which typically occurs when too much material is lost , or checkmate appears unavoidable .	checkmate	checkmate	material	material (chess)
